verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State documents a 'User Access' mechanism that lets an entity control who is authorized to submit online filings on its behalf. User Access becomes mandatory for Statement of Information filings from August 1, 2026, explicitly to prevent unauthorized submissions. That is a first-party delegation control, but the evidence does not show it publishing exactly what a third party may and may not do. missing for 10: published authorization forms, defined delegate roles/permission levels, rules on which signatures or attestations must remain personal to officers, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
